name: the-Remembered
clergy: the Rememberers' inner council; those who copy Old Weaver in secret and live by the sword
attitude_to_magic: The Glimmer is the song made audible; the-Remembered is the silence that made it forbidden.

worship_by_species.name: the-Remembered
worship_by_species.note: The Crownlands Reeve's court persecutes his worshipers; the Censer hunts them as the source of Old Weaver copies.

worship_by_species.name: the-Deep-Memory
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk know that every hold has its memory-stone; the-Remembered is the collective memory of the earth.

worship_by_species.name: the-Whisperer
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk name the old tongue's keeper the Whisperer; to speak his name is to invite the Grey Peace's end.

worship_by_species.name: the-Under-Singer
worship_by_species.note: The Rememberers of the Hollow Mile are his priests; he is the reason they risk the Edict of Silence.
